rationale: Stiven's deep expertise in machine learning, computer vision, and embedded systems directly complements Stephanie's ml-infra and multimodal AI background—both working in Python across overlapping technical domains. With Braillic raising $1M to hire engineers and navigate FDA processes, Stephanie's experience in scaling ML infrastructure and her prior exposure to high-growth company operations at SoftBank could offer valuable perspective on technical hiring and operational scaling.
intro_message: Stiven Ding, meet Stephanie Shi — you both work across ML and computer vision, and Stephanie's ml-infra and scaling experience may be useful as Braillic ramps up hiring and prepares for regulatory milestones.
